name: livetv-plus-webos
description: A clean live-TV home screen for LG webOS TVs: opens on a news channel instead of "No signal", with an app dock and News/Kids/Movies/Music rows. No root needed.
author: Asadullah Hil Galib

scripts.package: cp node_modules/hls.js/dist/hls.min.js webos-app/lib/ && rm -rf dist && ares-package webos-app webos-service -o dist
scripts.install-tv: ares-install --device tv dist/*.ipk && ares-launch --device tv com.devgalib.livetv
